cited.quote: an incentive of Rs.4,000/- per acre will be provided to farmers

rationale: C1 and C4 describe an organic farming incentive of Rs.4,000 per acre for 20,000 acres, announced for 2026-27. This differs from Rs.2,000 per month for three years to farmers transitioning from chemical farming, and is a budget or policy-note announcement, not an operational GO. No step for the promised assistance.

cited.quote: Every year, senior citizens aged between 60 and 70 are taken on spiritual pilgrimages funded by the Government.

rationale: No extract shows a Vaishnavite holy site tourism scheme covering Srirangam, Thirukoshtiyur or Azhwar Thirunagari. C4 mentions a senior citizen pilgrimage that includes Vaishnavite temples, which is a different scheme for a different purpose. Tourism extracts show no such scheme.

rationale: Cancer screening and NCD clinics (C1, C2, C3) are programmes begun before the government took office and merely continuing. No new GO or guideline on health monitoring and precautionary screening dated after 2026-05-10 appears.

rationale: C4 lists NCD screening and health walk programmes launched in 2023-2024 and only continuing. C2 mentions a leprosy awareness campaign held in January-February 2026, before the government took office and on a different subject. No new awareness campaign on health monitoring is shown.

rationale: C2 is the budget speech of 2026-08-05 announcing that people-friendly streets will be developed in all corporations. This is a statement of intent. C1 and C3 describe streetlight upkeep only. No GO, tender or sanction for the streets is shown.

None of the extracts concerns police transfers, postings or political interference. They cover law and order, special battalions, an anti-narcotics task force GO and cable television enforcement. Nothing relates to the indicator.

cited.quote: The Tamil Nadu Uniformed Services Recruitment Board was established in the year 1991

rationale: C1 and C3 describe the existing Uniformed Services Recruitment Board, set up in 1991, and its ongoing recruitment. No new board for police postings or recruitment oversight is shown; the other extracts are about unrelated matters (law officers, anti-narcotics units).

No extract concerns property tax structure or relief. C1 and C4 describe the Urban Land Tax Act, a different levy; C5 constitutes a revenue committee in general terms; C2 and C3 are general statements. Nothing is about a revised property tax.
No extract mentions a Tamil Taxi App or any taxi aggregator service. Extracts cover police citizen apps, state transport bus services and an anti-narcotics GO.
